label: ABC2_hR4_166_a_b_c-011
title: Li$_{2}$Mn$_{3}$O$_{7}$ Structure
comments:
The given stoichiometry is approximate, the lithium site is only 48\% occupied and the manganese site 89\%, so the true stoichiometry is Li$_{1.62}$Mn$_{3}$O$_{6.74}$. 
 (Raekelboom, 2001) label Li as being on the (3a) site and Mn on the (3b) site, but give the coordinates for (1b) and (1a) respectively.  The ICSD uses the coordinates, not the labels, and we follow them. 
 However, the AFLOW Label standard shifts the origin of the z-axis by 1/2 c, putting the lithium and manganese atoms on the (1a) and (1b) site and shifting $z_{3}$ from 0.2646 to 0.7646. 
 The ICSD assigns this to the \href{current_web_home_dir/ABC2_hR4_166_a_b_c-009}{NaFeO$_{2}$ structure type}, but we feel the vacancies warrant putting it into its own AFLOW prototype. 
 \href{current_web_home_dir/ABC2_hR4_166_a_b_c-009}{$\alpha$-NaFeO$_{2}$}, \href{current_web_home_dir/ABC2_hR4_166_a_b_c-004}{rhombohedral delafossite, CuFeO$_{2}$}, \href{current_web_home_dir/ABC2_hR4_166_a_b_c-001}{caswellsilverite ($F5_{1}$)}, \href{current_web_home_dir/ABC2_hR4_166_a_b_c-010}{LiNiO$_{2}$} and \href{current_web_home_dir/ABC2_hR4_166_a_b_c-011}{Li$_{2}$Mn$_{3}$O$_{7}$} have the same prototype label, ABC2\_hR4\_166\_a\_b\_c. The structures are generated by the same symmetry operations with different sets of parameters ({\tt --params}) specified in their corresponding CIF files. 
 Hexagonal settings of this structure can be obtained with the option {\tt --hex}.
